ideas.title: Following the Money in Minnesota Fraud Cases
ideas.description: This story would investigate the financial trails and potential corruption in Minnesota fraud cases, including the child care program and the killing of Alex Pretti.
questions: What are the financial implications of the fraud cases in Minnesota?
Are there any potential corruption or cover-ups involved?
ideas.insight: By following the money, we may uncover a larger pattern of corruption or fraud in Minnesota. This story has the potential to expose significant wrongdoing and hold those responsible accountable.
